skill.name: sitemapkit
skill.description: Discover sitemap files, extract URL lists, and run sitemap-based crawls for public websites through the SitemapKit MCP server.
skill.summary: Find website sitemaps and extract public URL lists with SitemapKit MCP tools.
skill.author: 0nl1n1n

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code formatting, setup examples, package metadata URLs, and placeholder API key configuration. I found one semantic issue. The package entry point references a dist binary that is not present in the audited repository.

remediation.issue: Runtime entry point is not auditable from the repository.
remediation.suggestion: Publish the source files or commit the built dist/index.js that matches the npm package before marketplace review.

remediation.issue: API key examples place secrets in client configuration files.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend environment variable substitution or secret manager references, and warn users not to commit files containing keys.

remediation.issue: Submitted domains and sitemap URLs are processed by an external service.
remediation.suggestion: Document the SitemapKit data flow and advise users not to submit private internal sites without authorization.

semantic_findings.title: Runtime Entry Point Not Present in Audited Source
semantic_findings.description: package.json points the executable and main module at dist/index.js and publishes only dist, while .gitignore excludes dist from the repository. Installing with npx may run package code that was not present in this audit.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The package entry points and files field clearly reference dist, and the audited file list does not include dist or source implementation files. This creates a strong review gap, although it does not prove malicious behavior.

content.value_statement: Finding every public URL on a site is slow when sitemaps are scattered or nested. This skill uses SitemapKit MCP tools to discover sitemaps, extract URLs, and report crawl limits.
actual_capabilities: Find sitemap files for a domain using robots.txt, common paths, and sitemap indexes.
Extract URL lists from a specific sitemap URL.
Run a full crawl across discovered sitemaps and return total URL counts.
Report quota metadata and truncated results when the MCP response includes them.
Guide tool choice between discover_sitemaps, extract_sitemap, and full_crawl.
limitations: Requires the sitemapkit MCP server and a valid SITEMAPKIT_API_KEY.
Only returns data available through sitemaps and SitemapKit responses.
discover_sitemaps and full_crawl use the domain only, so paths are ignored.
Rate limits and monthly quotas depend on the active SitemapKit plan.

use_cases.title: Map Site Coverage
use_cases.description: Find all sitemap files for a domain before planning an SEO crawl or content inventory.

use_cases.title: Export Public URLs
use_cases.description: Extract URLs from a known sitemap and review last modified dates when available.

use_cases.title: Check Crawl Scale
use_cases.description: Run a full sitemap crawl to estimate page counts and identify truncated results.

prompt_templates.title: Find Sitemaps
prompt_templates.prompt: Find all sitemaps for https://example.com and summarize where each sitemap was discovered.

prompt_templates.title: Extract One Sitemap
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the URLs from https://example.com/sitemap.xml and group the results by section if possible.

prompt_templates.title: Review Full URL List
prompt_templates.prompt: Get the full URL list for https://example.com, report the total count, and note whether the result was truncated.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Site Sections
prompt_templates.prompt: Discover the sitemaps for https://example.com, extract the main sitemap groups, and identify sections with the most URLs.

output_examples.output: The skill lists discovered sitemap URLs, shows whether they came from robots.txt or common paths, and reports the total sitemap count.

output_examples.input: Extract every URL from a product sitemap.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a clean URL list with last modified dates when SitemapKit provides them.

output_examples.input: How many pages does this site expose through sitemaps?
output_examples.output: The skill reports the total URL count, quota status, and whether the returned list reached the configured limit.

best_practices: Use a full URL with the protocol for every request.
Start with sitemap discovery when the exact sitemap URL is unknown.
Check quota and truncation fields before treating a URL list as complete.
anti_patterns: Do not use full_crawl when a single known sitemap is enough.
Do not treat sitemap results as proof that unpublished pages do not exist.
Do not crawl private or internal sites without clear authorization.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The SitemapKit MCP server must be configured with SITEMAPKIT_API_KEY.

faq.question: Can it find sitemaps when the user does not know the sitemap URL?
faq.answer: Yes. It can discover sitemaps for a domain before extracting URLs.

faq.question: Can it extract one specific sitemap file?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the exact sitemap URL when the target file is already known.

faq.question: Does it crawl pages like a browser?
faq.answer: No. It works from sitemap discovery and extraction results provided by SitemapKit.

faq.question: What happens when the result is truncated?
faq.answer: The skill should report truncation and suggest increasing max_urls when the plan allows it.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through the MCP workflow.
